title: Trade Agreement With US Close to Completion, Thai Prime Minister Says
author: Sebastian Strangio
text:
Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul addresses a meeting on the economic impacts of the Iran war in Bangkok, Thailand, Mar. 2, 2026.
Credit: Facebook/Bhumjaithai Party
Trade negotiations between Thailand and the United States are in the final stages and an agreement is expected to be signed as soon as next month, Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said yesterday.Speaking at a forum ​in Singapore, Anutin said negotiations on the Agreement on ⁠Reciprocal Trade (ART) are now on “the last ​paragraph” and that he ​expected to sign the final agreement during U.S. President Donald Trump’s next visit to Asia, Reuters reported. This could take place during the ASEAN Summit in the Philippines on November 16–18, which Trump has confirmed he is attending, or the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meetings in Shenzhen on November 18–19. Trump’s attendance at the latter summit has not yet been confirmed.[...]
